units.source_text: 风把手巾吹了起来。

en.t: The wind blew the towel up.

units.source_text: 沙丘的一条棱线闪着金光，映入眼角。

en.t: One ridge of the dune flashed gold and caught the corner of his eye.

units.source_text: 缓缓高涨起来的曲面，以那条金黄线为界，以一个笔直的角度滑入了阴影里。

en.t: The gently swelling curved surface, divided by that golden line, slid at a straight angle into shadow.

units.source_text: 这个空间的构成里，有异常紧迫的感觉。

en.t: There was an unusually urgent feeling in the composition of that space.

units.source_text: 男人被一种神秘的情绪控制着，

en.t: The man was held under the control of a mysterious emotion,

units.source_text: 想碰上个什么人，这不禁使他打了个寒战。

en.t: and the thought of running into someone made him shudder in spite of himself.
--(Not bad.

units.source_text: 真是罗曼蒂克的风景……

en.t: It really is a romantic landscape...

units.source_text: 只有这种风景才大受最近年轻游客的欢迎……

en.t: This is exactly the kind of scenery that young tourists go for these days...

units.source_text: 了不起的绩优股呀……

en.t: A first-rate blue-chip prospect...

units.source_text: 作为此道的经验者，绝对能保证将来的发展哟。

en.t: As someone experienced in this line, I can absolutely guarantee its future growth.

units.source_text: 所以，首先得赶快宣传！

en.t: So first of all, we have to hurry up and publicize it!

units.source_text: 不宣传，连苍蝇都不肯靠近……

en.t: Without publicity, even flies would refuse to come near...

units.source_text: 说不知道，跟没有一个样呐……

en.t: If nobody knows about it, it is the same as not existing at all...

units.source_text: 真是抱着金碗讨饭。

en.t: It is like begging while holding a golden bowl.

units.source_text: 可怎么做才好呢？……

en.t: But what should be done?...

units.source_text: 找个技术好的摄影师制作一套漂亮、精致的明信片。

en.t: Find a skilled photographer and have a beautiful, finely made set of postcards produced.

units.source_text: 过去是先有名胜地，然后才有明信片……

en.t: In the past, first there was a famous scenic spot, and only then came the postcards...

units.source_text: 可这回先做明信片……

en.t: But this time, make the postcards first...

units.source_text: 然后，才有名胜，这也是常识哇。

en.t: Then the scenic attraction will come into being; that is common sense too.

units.source_text: 于是拿两三个样本去，至少请人看看这玩意儿）——

en.t: So take two or three samples around and at least get people to look at the thing)--

units.source_text: 想下圈套，反而把自己给套住，就那样病死了，

en.t: He tried to set a trap, only to get caught in it himself, and died of illness just like that,

units.source_text: 那个可怜的明信片推销员。

en.t: that poor postcard salesman.

units.source_text: 不过，无法想象那个明信片推销员有着三寸不烂之舌……

en.t: Still, it was hard to imagine that postcard salesman being silver-tongued...

units.source_text: 也许他出人意料的认真，

en.t: Perhaps he was unexpectedly serious,

units.source_text: 将梦想托付给这里的风景，赌上了事业……

en.t: entrusting his dreams to the scenery here and staking his business on it...

units.source_text: 这美好的原型，究竟是什么呢？

en.t: What, after all, was this beautiful archetype?

units.source_text: 到底是因为自然所拥有的物理规律的正确性呢，

en.t: Was it because of the exactness of the physical laws possessed by nature,

units.source_text: 还是由于不断排斥对人理解的无慈悲心呢？

en.t: or because of a mercilessness that constantly rejected human understanding?
